list_child.name: list_matches
list_child.desc: Retrieves every mentor-youth match currently tracked by the program, whether it is proposed, active, paused, or closed. Use this when you need a full picture of the caseload rather than a single match.

get_child.name: get_match
get_child.desc: Retrieves the full detail for a single mentor-youth match using its id. This is the right call once you already know which match you need to inspect.

list_parent.name: list_mentors
list_parent.desc: Retrieves the full roster of mentors enrolled in the program, including those not currently paired with a youth. Use this to look up a mentor before creating or referencing a match.

get_parent.name: get_mentor
get_parent.desc: Retrieves the full detail for a single mentor using their id. This is useful whenever you already have a mentor id and need their record.

delete_child.name: delete_match
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes a mentor-youth match record from the program's system, and the action cannot be reversed once it runs. This should only be used for records created in error, not for matches that simply ended.

set_enum.name: set_match_phase
set_enum.desc: Changes a match's phase to proposed, active, paused, or closed so the caseload reflects where the pairing currently stands. Use this whenever a match moves forward, pauses, or wraps up.

set_bool.name: flag_needs_new_mentor
set_bool.desc: Flags a match as needing reassignment to a new mentor, which coordinators use when a pairing is not working out. This should be reserved for matches that genuinely need to be restarted.

set_ref.name: reassign_mentor
set_ref.desc: Moves a match onto a different mentor's caseload, which is useful when a pairing needs to be handled by someone else entirely. This does not change anything else recorded about the match.

send.name: email_mentor
send.desc: Sends an email to a mentor's address on file, letting them know about a status change or asking them to check in with their match. This is the main way coordinators reach mentors outside of scheduled meetings.
